class.name: OpenXRSpatialMeshTrackingCapability
class.brief_description: Implementation for handling spatial entity mesh tracking logic.
class.description: This class handles the OpenXR mesh tracking spatial entity extension.

method.name: get_built_in_tracking_state
method.description: Returns the state of the built-in tracking system.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if mesh tracking is supported and enabled.

method.name: is_watertight_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if watertight meshes are supported.

method.name: start_built_in_tracking
method.description: Starts the built-in mesh tracking logic. [param watertight_mode] allows you to specify whether you request or require watertight meshes. This will fail if built-in tracking is already enabled.

method.name: start_entity_discovery
method.description: Calls [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.discover_spatial_entities] and [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.query_snapshot] with the mesh entities associated with [param spatial_context]. [param component_data] are the [OpenXRSpatialComponentData]s to discover for this mesh capability. If [param next_snapshot_create] is non-null, then pass this to the [code]next[/code] parameter in [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.discover_spatial_entities]. If [param next_snapshot_query] is non-null, then pass this to the [code]next[/code] parameter in [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.query_snapshot]. [param user_callback], when non-null, is called with two parameters usually twice. The first parameter is the [RID] of the discovery snapshot and the second parameter is a boolean where [code]false[/code] indicates the discovery snapshot is about to be processed, and [code]true[/code] indicates the discovery snapshot has been processed and [param component_data] has valid data. The second call is skipped if an error was encountered. The returned [OpenXRFutureResult] is identical to the return from [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.discover_spatial_entities].

method.name: stop_built_in_tracking
method.description: Stops the built-in mesh tracking logic.
